$comment: Agent notes for editing, deleting and reacting to messages. Shape and rules: scripts/api_notes.py. Every pitfall carries its source label; API means the catalog text quoted in cite.

editMessageText.purpose: Replace the text or rich content of a message the bot sent, or of an inline message, in place.
use_when: a screen changes inside one flow: navigation, progress, status
avoid_when: the event is new and must stay in history: send a new message

pitfalls.text: Send text (1-4096 characters after parsing) or rich_message; one of the two is required.
pitfalls.cite: text: required if rich_message isn't specified; rich_message: required if text isn't specified

pitfalls.text: Target is chat_id + message_id, or inline_message_id; an inline message returns True, not a Message.
pitfalls.cite: message_id: Required if inline_message_id is not specified.

pitfalls.text: Business messages the bot did not send, without an inline keyboard, are editable only within 48 hours.
pitfalls.cite: editMessageText: business messages that were not sent by the bot and do not contain an inline keyboard can only be edited within 48 hours from the time they were sent

pitfalls.text: Identical content and markup fails with 400 'message is not modified': compare before editing.

editMessageCaption.purpose: Change the caption of a media message the bot sent, or of an inline media message.
use_when: the key fact of a photo, video or document post changes
avoid_when: the message is text or rich: editMessageText
the media itself changes: editMessageMedia

pitfalls.text: caption is 0-1024 characters after entities parsing.
pitfalls.cite: caption: New caption of the message, 0-1024 characters after entities parsing

pitfalls.text: show_caption_above_media works only for animation, photo and video messages.
pitfalls.cite: show_caption_above_media: Supported only for animation, photo and video messages.

pitfalls.text: Target is chat_id + message_id, or inline_message_id; an inline message returns True, not a Message.
pitfalls.cite: message_id: Required if inline_message_id is not specified.

pitfalls.text: Business messages the bot did not send, without an inline keyboard, are editable only within 48 hours.
pitfalls.cite: editMessageCaption: ... can only be edited within 48 hours from the time they were sent

editMessageMedia.purpose: Replace the media of a message, or turn a text or rich message into a media message.
use_when: swap a photo or file in a published post
a text message becomes a media message
avoid_when: only the caption changes: editMessageCaption

pitfalls.text: Inside an album: audio only to audio, document only to document, otherwise photo, live photo or video.
pitfalls.cite: editMessageMedia: it can be edited only to an audio for audio albums, only to a document for document albums and to a photo, a live photo, or a video otherwise

pitfalls.text: An inline message takes no new upload: use a file_id or a URL.
pitfalls.cite: editMessageMedia: When an inline message is edited, a new file can't be uploaded

pitfalls.text: media is an InputMedia, and its type picks the member; a file_id is the recommended way to pass a known file.
pitfalls.cite: InputMediaPhoto.media: Pass a file_id to send a file that exists on the Telegram servers (recommended)

pitfalls.text: Business messages the bot did not send, without an inline keyboard, are editable only within 48 hours.
pitfalls.cite: editMessageMedia: ... can only be edited within 48 hours from the time they were sent

editMessageLiveLocation.purpose: Move a live location message to new coordinates, or extend how long it can be updated.
use_when: a tracked courier, ride or shift position changes
avoid_when: the location is a fixed place: send it once with sendLocation

pitfalls.text: Editable until live_period expires or stopMessageLiveLocation is called.
pitfalls.cite: editMessageLiveLocation: A location can be edited until its live_period expires or editing is explicitly disabled by a call to stopMessageLiveLocation

pitfalls.text: A new live_period may exceed the current one by at most a day and must expire within 90 days; 0x7FFFFFFF means forever.
pitfalls.cite: live_period: If 0x7FFFFFFF is specified, then the location can be updated forever. Otherwise, the new value must not exceed the current live_period by more than a day

pitfalls.text: horizontal_accuracy 0-1500 m, heading 1-360, proximity_alert_radius 1-100000 m.
pitfalls.cite: heading: Must be between 1 and 360 if specified; proximity_alert_radius: Must be between 1 and 100000 if specified

pitfalls.text: Throttle position updates; on a flood wait skip the frame instead of retrying in a loop.

stopMessageLiveLocation.purpose: End a live location message before its live_period expires.
use_when: the journey, shift or session that fed the location is over
avoid_when: the location should simply run out: it stops updating when live_period expires

pitfalls.text: After the stop, editMessageLiveLocation can no longer move the location.
pitfalls.cite: editMessageLiveLocation: editing is explicitly disabled by a call to stopMessageLiveLocation

pitfalls.text: Target is chat_id + message_id, or inline_message_id; an inline message returns True, not a Message.
pitfalls.cite: stopMessageLiveLocation: if the message is not an inline message, the edited Message is returned, otherwise True is returned

pitfalls.text: Call it when the feeding session ends, not only at expiry.

editMessageChecklist.purpose: Replace a checklist the bot sent on behalf of a connected business account.
use_when: the title or tasks of a checklist sent for a business account change
avoid_when: there is no business connection: business_connection_id is required

pitfalls.text: business_connection_id, chat_id, message_id and checklist are all required; the result is the edited Message.
pitfalls.cite: editMessageChecklist: Use this method to edit a checklist on behalf of a connected business account.

pitfalls.text: InputChecklist: title 1-255 characters, 1-30 tasks, task text 1-100, task id positive and unique among current tasks.
pitfalls.cite: InputChecklist.tasks: List of 1-30 tasks in the checklist; InputChecklistTask.id: must be positive and unique among all task identifiers currently present in the checklist

pitfalls.text: Send the whole new checklist: keep the ids of unchanged tasks, give new tasks new ids.

editMessageReplyMarkup.purpose: Swap the inline keyboard of a message without touching its text or media.
use_when: toggle states, show a confirmation row
a finished screen must stop accepting taps
avoid_when: the text or media must change too: editMessageText, editMessageMedia

pitfalls.text: Target is chat_id + message_id, or inline_message_id; an inline message returns True, not a Message.
pitfalls.cite: message_id: Required if inline_message_id is not specified.

pitfalls.text: Business messages the bot did not send, without an inline keyboard, are editable only within 48 hours.
pitfalls.cite: editMessageReplyMarkup: ... can only be edited within 48 hours from the time they were sent

pitfalls.text: Omitting reply_markup, or an empty keyboard, removes the keyboard.
A disabled keyboard is not idempotency: re-check state on the server for every stale tap.

stopPoll.purpose: Close a poll the bot sent and get the final Poll with its results.
use_when: a vote or quiz must end now, before its close time
avoid_when: the poll has a known end: set open_period or close_date in sendPoll

pitfalls.text: Only a poll the bot itself sent; chat_id and message_id are both required.
pitfalls.cite: stopPoll: stop a poll which was sent by the bot

pitfalls.text: No inline_message_id parameter, so it cannot stop a poll in an inline message.
pitfalls.cite: stopPoll parameters: business_connection_id, chat_id, message_id, reply_markup

pitfalls.text: Returns the stopped Poll, not a Message.
pitfalls.cite: stopPoll: On success, the stopped Poll is returned.

pitfalls.text: Keep (chat_id, message_id) for every poll you send; the stop call needs both.

deleteMessage.purpose: Delete one message, within the limits of its age, type and the bot's rights.
use_when: remove the bot's own stale or wrong message
moderation in a group the bot administers
avoid_when: the message can be corrected: edit it and keep views and replies

pitfalls.text: Only messages sent less than 48 hours ago; a dice message in a private chat only after 24 hours.
pitfalls.cite: deleteMessage: A message can only be deleted if it was sent less than 48 hours ago.

pitfalls.text: Creation service messages of a supergroup, channel or forum topic can't be deleted.
pitfalls.cite: deleteMessage: Service messages about a supergroup, channel, or forum topic creation can't be deleted.

pitfalls.text: No inline_message_id, so an inline message can't be deleted: edit it to a closed state.
pitfalls.cite: deleteMessage parameters: chat_id, message_id

deleteMessage.rights: own channel posts: can_post_messages; any message in a supergroup or channel: can_delete_messages; direct messages chat: can_manage_direct_messages

deleteMessages.purpose: Delete 1-100 messages in one request; messages that can't be found are skipped.
use_when: clean up a batch: a finished flow, a moderated thread
avoid_when: a single message: deleteMessage

pitfalls.text: message_ids holds 1-100 identifiers.
pitfalls.cite: message_ids: A JSON-serialized list of 1-100 identifiers of messages to delete.

pitfalls.text: Messages that can't be found are skipped, and the result is plain True with no per-message outcome.
pitfalls.cite: deleteMessages: If some of the specified messages can't be found, they are skipped. Returns True on success.

pitfalls.text: The limits of deleteMessage (age, message type, rights) apply to every id.
pitfalls.cite: message_ids: See deleteMessage for limitations on which messages can be deleted.

setMessageReaction.purpose: Set or change the bot's reaction on a message.
use_when: a cheap acknowledgement: seen, done
avoid_when: the user needs details or a next step: reply with a message

pitfalls.text: A bot sets at most one reaction per message and can't use paid reactions.
pitfalls.cite: reaction: Currently, as non-premium users, bots can set up to one reaction per message. Paid reactions can't be used by bots.

pitfalls.text: A custom emoji reaction works only if already on the message or allowed by chat administrators.
pitfalls.cite: reaction: A custom emoji reaction can be used if it is either already present on the message or explicitly allowed by chat administrators.

pitfalls.text: In a media group the reaction goes to the first non-deleted message of the group.
pitfalls.cite: message_id: If the message belongs to a media group, the reaction is set to the first non-deleted message in the group instead.

pitfalls.text: An empty or omitted reaction clears the bot's reaction.
A failure is cosmetic: log it, never retry in a loop, never block the real reply.

deleteMessageReaction.purpose: Remove one user's or chat's reaction from a message in a group or supergroup (moderation).
use_when: a single abusive reaction on one message
avoid_when: many reactions by one actor: deleteAllMessageReactions

pitfalls.text: Group and supergroup chats only; the bot needs the can_delete_messages administrator right.
pitfalls.cite: deleteMessageReaction: remove a reaction from a message in a group or a supergroup chat. The bot must have the 'can_delete_messages' administrator right

pitfalls.text: Name the actor: user_id for a user's reaction, actor_chat_id for a chat's.
pitfalls.cite: user_id: ... if the reaction was added by a user; actor_chat_id: ... if the reaction was added by a chat

deleteAllMessageReactions.purpose: Remove up to 10000 recent reactions added by one user or chat in a group or supergroup.
use_when: a spammer or a reaction-bombing account is moderated
avoid_when: one message only: deleteMessageReaction

pitfalls.text: No message_id: it clears that actor's recent reactions across the chat, up to 10000.
pitfalls.cite: deleteAllMessageReactions: remove up to 10000 recent reactions in a group or a supergroup chat added by a given user or chat

pitfalls.text: Group and supergroup chats only; the bot needs the can_delete_messages administrator right.
pitfalls.cite: deleteAllMessageReactions: The bot must have the 'can_delete_messages' administrator right in the chat.

pitfalls.text: Name the actor: user_id for a user, actor_chat_id for a chat.
pitfalls.cite: user_id: ... if the reactions were added by a user; actor_chat_id: ... if added by a chat

pitfalls.text: There is no undo: log who was cleared and why.

editEphemeralMessageText.purpose: Edit the text or rich content of an ephemeral message that only one user sees.
use_when: a personal panel in a group changes after the user's tap
avoid_when: the message is a regular one: editMessageText

pitfalls.text: The user may not receive the edit, especially when offline.
pitfalls.cite: editEphemeralMessageText: it is not guaranteed that the user will receive the message edit event, especially if they are offline

pitfalls.text: Needs chat_id, receiver_user_id and ephemeral_message_id from the sent Message (its message_id is 0); the id may be reused after delete or expiry.
pitfalls.cite: Message.ephemeral_message_id: The identifier may be reused for another ephemeral message after the message is deleted or expires.

pitfalls.text: Send text (1-4096 characters) or rich_message; the result is True, not a Message.
pitfalls.cite: text: required if rich_message isn't specified; rich_message: required if text isn't specified

pitfalls.text: Never make correctness depend on the edit landing; re-check state on the next tap.

editEphemeralMessageCaption.purpose: Edit the caption of an ephemeral media message that only one user sees.
use_when: a personal media card needs a new caption
avoid_when: the message is a regular one: editMessageCaption

pitfalls.text: The user may not receive the edit, especially when offline.
pitfalls.cite: editEphemeralMessageCaption: it is not guaranteed that the user will receive the message edit event, especially if they are offline

pitfalls.text: caption is 0-1024 characters; show_caption_above_media works only for animation, photo and video.
pitfalls.cite: show_caption_above_media: Supported only for animation, photo and video messages.

pitfalls.text: Needs chat_id, receiver_user_id and ephemeral_message_id; the result is True, not a Message.
pitfalls.cite: editEphemeralMessageCaption: On success, True is returned.

editEphemeralMessageMedia.purpose: Replace the media of an ephemeral message that only one user sees.
use_when: a personal media card swaps its picture or file
avoid_when: the message is a regular one: editMessageMedia

pitfalls.text: The user may not receive the edit, especially when offline.
pitfalls.cite: editEphemeralMessageMedia: it is not guaranteed that the user will receive the message edit event, especially if they are offline

pitfalls.text: New files can be uploaded since 10.3; a file_id still avoids the upload.
pitfalls.cite: changelog 10.3: Supported upload of new files in editEphemeralMessageMedia.

pitfalls.text: media is an InputMedia; the result is True, not a Message.
pitfalls.cite: editEphemeralMessageMedia: On success, True is returned.

editEphemeralMessageReplyMarkup.purpose: Swap only the inline keyboard of an ephemeral message that only one user sees.
use_when: a personal panel moves to its next step or disables a used button
avoid_when: the text changes too: editEphemeralMessageText

pitfalls.text: The user may not receive the edit, especially when offline.
pitfalls.cite: editEphemeralMessageReplyMarkup: it is not guaranteed that the user will receive the message edit event, especially if they are offline

pitfalls.text: Needs chat_id, receiver_user_id and ephemeral_message_id; the result is True, not a Message.
pitfalls.cite: editEphemeralMessageReplyMarkup: On success, True is returned.

pitfalls.text: Treat buttons of an old panel as stale: re-check state on the tap and answer 'expired'.

deleteEphemeralMessage.purpose: Delete an ephemeral message that only one user sees.
use_when: a personal panel is finished or superseded
avoid_when: the message is a regular one: deleteMessage

pitfalls.text: The user may not receive the deletion, especially when offline.
pitfalls.cite: deleteEphemeralMessage: it is not guaranteed that the user will receive the message deletion event, especially if they are offline

pitfalls.text: Needs chat_id, receiver_user_id and ephemeral_message_id; all three are required.
pitfalls.cite: deleteEphemeralMessage parameters: chat_id, receiver_user_id, ephemeral_message_id (all required)

pitfalls.text: The id may be reused for a new ephemeral message after deletion: drop your stored id.
pitfalls.cite: Message.ephemeral_message_id: The identifier may be reused for another ephemeral message after the message is deleted or expires.

approveSuggestedPost.purpose: Approve a suggested post in a channel's direct messages chat, optionally setting its publish time.
use_when: the editor accepts a post a user or bot suggested to the channel
avoid_when: the post should be refused: declineSuggestedPost

pitfalls.text: The bot needs can_post_messages in the corresponding channel; chat_id is the direct messages chat, an Integer.
pitfalls.cite: approveSuggestedPost: The bot must have the 'can_post_messages' administrator right in the corresponding channel chat.

pitfalls.text: send_date: omit it if a date was set when the post was suggested; at most 2678400 seconds (30 days) ahead.
pitfalls.cite: send_date: omit if the date has already been specified when the suggested post was created ... not more than 2678400 seconds (30 days) in the future

pitfalls.text: An approved or declined suggested post can't be edited.
pitfalls.cite: Message.suggested_post_info: If the message is an approved or declined suggested post, then it can't be edited.

declineSuggestedPost.purpose: Decline a suggested post in a channel's direct messages chat, with an optional comment for its creator.
use_when: the editor refuses a suggested post and wants to say why
avoid_when: the post should go out: approveSuggestedPost

pitfalls.text: The bot needs can_manage_direct_messages in the channel, not can_post_messages as for approving.
pitfalls.cite: declineSuggestedPost: The bot must have the 'can_manage_direct_messages' administrator right in the corresponding channel chat.

pitfalls.text: comment is 0-128 characters and goes to the creator of the post.
pitfalls.cite: comment: Comment for the creator of the suggested post; 0-128 characters

pitfalls.text: An approved or declined suggested post can't be edited.
pitfalls.cite: Message.suggested_post_info: If the message is an approved or declined suggested post, then it can't be edited.
